The code snippet provided contains a critical dependency issue. It imports `pandas` and `numpy`, but the comment explicitly notes that an outdated version of pandas is being used, which has known compatibility issues with the current version of numpy. This mismatch can lead to runtime errors, unexpected behavior, or crashes when the library functions are executed. To resolve this, you should update pandas to a version that is compatible with your installed numpy version, or downgrade numpy to a version compatible with the existing pandas installation.
